name: Emmental
siboNotes: As a hard aged cheese, Emmental is naturally lactose-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. The aging process breaks down lactose completely.
preparationTips: Buy pre-sliced or grate fresh for best flavor
Store wrapped in wax paper in refrigerator
Allow to come to room temperature before serving for optimal taste
Pairs excellently melted in sandwiches or fondues
nutritionalHighlights: High in calcium for bone health
Provides phosphorus for teeth and bones
